summary: Absci Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce interim Phase 1 data from its HEADLINE trial of ABS-201, a novel antibody targeting the prolactin receptor. The press release details safety, pharmacokinetic, and immunogenicity results from 32 healthy volunteers across four single ascending dose cohorts. No special-situation corporate transaction is disclosed—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a routine clinical-data press release.
